aboutGame.title: From a tiny ball to the universe
paragraphs: Roll the World is an incremental Roblox game by overzeer. Start as a tiny ball, collect smaller objects and grow from grass and bugs to cars and city streets. Your size decides what you can roll up next.

Spend stardust on upgrades and equip finds that improve your run. Making stars restarts your size with stronger progression, and the sixth star at size 300 opens space. Day and night, seasonal events and rarer finds give you more to explore.

footer.about: An independent fan guide to Roll the World on Roblox. We explain progression with developer information and reviewed community gameplay. This site is not affiliated with Roblox or overzeer.
footer.description: Stars, stardust upgrades, finds and a practical route from your first roll to space.
